changelog.message: op created for high-performance Swift-backed native Syphon Out publishing
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Publishes a Cables WebGL texture as a native macOS Syphon server using a high-performance native Swift-backed sidecar process and Metal.

ports.name: Render
ports.text: Trigger input to publish the texture frame to the Syphon server.

ports.name: Texture
ports.text: The WebGL input texture you wish to publish to the system.

ports.name: Server Name
ports.text: The name of the published Syphon server (visible in client applications).

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the sidecar daemon.
